description: Na₂NiCSO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.93 Å. Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form NiO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.15 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.26-1.32 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-52°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.49-1.51 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ni, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ni, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ni, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ni, and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ni, and one S atom.
